How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
Orders placed by 12 PM EST are typically processed and shipped out the same day! Orders placed on weekends or holidays are processed on the next business day.
Once your order ships, tracking details are sent automatically. However, on rare occasions when an item is out of stock, processing can take up to 7 business days.

Delivery times depend on the shipping method selected at checkout and your location. For domestic orders in the continental U.S., packages ship via UPS or USPS. Upgraded options like Second Day or Next Day Air Service are also available at checkout.
For international orders, shipping times vary based on the carrier (UPS or USPS) and any local customs inspection processes in your destination country.
